title: requirements.json
description: Testable requirements. Sole writer: product. Every acceptance criterion must be verifiable by an agent that never spoke to the human.

goal.description: One sentence a non-author would understand. What outcome, for whom.

actors.description: "The user" is almost never specific enough. Name the roles and their permissions.

story.description: As a <actor>, I want <capability>, so that <outcome>.

acceptance_criteria.description: Atomic, observable, independently verifiable. IDs are referenced by plan.json and qa-report.json.

text.description: The observable condition that must hold.

verification_method.description: How another agent can check this without asking the author.

business_rules.description: Invariants that must hold across all paths.

edge_cases.description: Enumerate explicitly: empty, duplicate, expired, unauthorized, concurrent, already-done, partial failure, missing dependency, boundary values.

out_of_scope.description: A boundary that is not written down will be crossed. At least one entry is required.

assumptions.description: Every assumption, with the impact if it turns out to be wrong.

open_questions.description: Unresolved product decisions. Non-empty means the workflow must stop and ask the human.

blocks.description: What cannot proceed until this is answered.

ux_dimension.description: True when this requirement has a user-facing experience component and UX should be activated.
